sourceReview.excerpt:
##### **Explore the use of brackets and the order of operations to write number sentences**

- Recognise the need to agree on the order in which to perform
  operations

+------------------------------------------------------------------+
|**Example(s):**|
||
|Two different answers are possible when evaluating|
|$$4 + 8 \div 2 = \ \ \ \ \ ⃞$$.|
+------------------------------------------------------------------+

- Use grouping symbols () in number sentences to indicate operations
  that must be performed first

+------------------------------------------------------------------+
|**Example(s):**|
||
|Explain where to put brackets in a number sentence to make the|
|statement true $$2 + 4 \times 7 = 42$$.|
+------------------------------------------------------------------+

- Investigate the order of operations using real-life contexts

+------------------------------------------------------------------+
|**Example(s):**|
||
|'I buy 6 bull roarers costing \$10 each and 2 sets of|
|clapsticks costing \$4 each. What is the total cost?\' This can|
|be represented by the number sentence|
|$$6 \times 10 + 2 \times 4$$ but to obtain the total cost,|
|multiplication must be performed before addition.|
+------------------------------------------------------------------+

- Solve problems involving grouping symbols

+------------------------------------------------------------------+
|**Example(s):**|
||
|Such as $$5 + (2 \times 3) = 5 + 6 = 11$$.|
+------------------------------------------------------------------+

###  ******Representing quantity fractions A**
